subject: Run the TUNED ablation - these are the thesis numbers
description: srq1_holiday_ablation_tuned.py: separate Optuna study per arm per model (tune on val, refit train+val, score test once), plus Ridge with CV-selected alpha. The untuned result confounds feature change with frozen capacity. DONE 2026-09-06: helped in 6/12 (mean -0.75pp) vs 4/12 untuned. Tuning improved the danskvand baseline by ~12pp, which flipped that category from harmful to helpful -- the frozen-capacity confound was real. See findings F16; these supersede F10.
